title: The Wick fourth-chaos vector has sharp negative free-Hamiltonian scale threshold five

negative_scale.lower_dyadic_blocks: Disjoint comparable-momentum cone blocks of radius R contribute at least c R^(5-s); therefore S_s diverges for s<5 and has a non-summable constant contribution per dyadic block at s=5
negative_scale.upper_dyadic_blocks: Order dyadic radii L~N1~N2>=N3>=N4, use momentum conservation to count by k1,k3,k4, and sum L^3 N3^3 N4^3 times L^-2 N3^-1 N4^-1; each largest-radius block is at most C L^5, so the weighted series converges for s>5
negative_scale.sharp_threshold: W_N converges in the negative Hilbert scale D((H_0+1)^(-s/2)) for every s>5 and is unbounded there for every s<=5
negative_scale.interpretation: Free-Hamiltonian smoothing exists only more than five powers below the Fock energy operator for this vacuum-to-four-particle vector; the ordinary form-dual exponent s=1 is far below threshold
negative_scale.scope: This is a sharp statement for W_N Omega in the declared Gaussian/Fock control, not a construction of the full multiplication form on arbitrary states
